mapper.select: SELECT pq.id, pq.product_id, pq.user_id, TRIM(CONCAT(COALESCE(u.first_name, ''), ' ', COALESCE(u.last_name, ''))) AS customer_name, pq.question, pq.answer, pq.status, pq.is_active, pq.created_at, pq.answered_at, pq.updated_at FROM product_questions pq LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = pq.user_id WHERE pq.product_id = #{product_id} AND pq.is_active = 1 ORDER BY pq.created_at DESC, pq.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO product_questions ( product_id, user_id, question, status, is_active, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{product_id}, #{user_id}, #{question}, 'WAITING', 1, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE product_questions SET answer = #{answer}, status = 'ANSWERED', answered_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_active = 1
